content: Neon provides a managed PgBouncer pooler via the -pooler hostname (transaction pooling mode, up to 10k conns). With PgBouncer transaction mode, protocol-level prepared statements are problematic: psycopg3 >=3.2 works with PgBouncer >=1.22, otherwise set prepare_threshold=None. For orchestrator: use the pooled Neon URL, disable/limit prepared statements, keep SQLAlchemy pool small (pool_size 5) with pool_pre_ping=True, and rely on row locks/conditional UPDATE for run concurrency.
